---
title: "ISOPlot subplots by location"
description: "Split an ISOPlot into panels and colour by session."
date: 2026-01-08
categories: [ISOPlot, subplots]
---

```{python}
#| label: fig-isoplot-subplots
#| fig-alt: "ISOPlot panels by location, coloured by session"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import soundscapy as sspy

data = pd.read_csv("../../assets/DemoData.csv")

places = ["CamdenTown", "PancrasLock", "RegentsParkJapan", "RegentsParkFields"]
subset = data[data["LocationID"].isin(places)]

(
    sspy.ISOPlot(data=subset, title=None, hue="SessionID")
    .create_subplots(
        subplot_by="LocationID",
        figsize=(4, 4),
        auto_allocate_axes=True,
    )
    .add_scatter()
    .add_simple_density(fill=False)
    .style(title_fontsize=14, diagonal_lines=True)
)
plt.show()
```
